title: Prepared variant-level regression input for the epilepsy unified meta-regression
description:
Shared by private link, not published. This table is derived from Epi25 case and control allele counts. It is provided to named collaborators for reproduction of AJHG-D-24-00613 and is not for onward redistribution.

The prepared variant-level table that feeds the unified meta-regression: one row per variant, gene and epilepsy subtype, carrying allele counts, effect sizes, HMM constraint, GERP RS and AlphaMissense pathogenicity. It is the output of pipelines/01_build_regression_input.py at https://github.com/healthcare-medicine-ai/wgs-constraint-llm, branch gerp-am-corrections, where the column definitions and analysis parameters are documented.

File properties. Gzipped TSV, 9,620,584 rows, 181,710,689 bytes. md5 of the compressed file bd6e909a1fce473fd31190b863df42bb; md5 of the decompressed stream 681f3a4c172e7432e7f4f0cebd5cfcad.

Inputs. Epi25 variant results; GENCODE v44 basic annotation (md5 7450ef42cf9cb3d29625320b22d4bb45); AlphaMissense hg38 isoform-level release; HMM constraint predictions (doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.27184245); GERP RS for GRCh38 (doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.33201549).
